_comment: GOA daily fasting designations, harvested 2026-09-09 from goarch.org/chapel/calendar?month=M&year=Y&viewStyle=GridView&viewType=ViewReadings via a real browser (Cloudflare blocks scripted access; the user cleared the interstitial, then months were fetched same-origin). The grid encodes fasting as a CSS class on div.day, NOT in the page text: 'strict-fast'=S, 'grapes'=W (wine and oil), 'fasting-fish'=F, absent=N (fast free). Mapping confirmed against March 2026, where Lenten weekdays are S, weekends W, and the Annunciation is F. One character per day, index 0 = the 1st.
